description: Returns the current public menu of one business: every active item with name, description, price, category, tags, a sold-out flag and an image URL. Prices are in US dollars. For a business with menu_source "event" (food trucks), this is the full catalog of everything it sells; what is sold on a given day is listed per stop in the upcoming-events data, and the note field states this. The response includes the business summary with the order page URL when ordering is open.
name: get_menu
title: Get the menu
